repomix.user_provided_header: Phases 5 and 6: Customers, Retail Store Authentication, Wholesale Registration and Approval, Private Customer Documents, Addresses and Cities, Public Storefront Catalog, Home Banners, Product Filters, Similar Products, Customer-aware Pricing and Online Stock Availability. Includes current implementation and audit fixes, API routes, validation, resources, notifications and SMS gateway integration, shared models/enums, complete schema migration history and seed/factory context, relevant automated tests, and related frontend files. Frontend files may be empty scaffolds and are included for context, not as evidence of implemented UI. PostgreSQL is required. products.is_active is generated from publication status; base_price is generated from retail_price. Password reset keys are namespaced by customer ID. Real email/SMS delivery requires external provider configuration. Paths are relative to the repository root. Source contents are preserved, including comments and line numbers.
